headword: {教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい}
gloss: curriculum; educational program; course of study

definitions.gloss: curriculum; educational program; course of study
definitions.explanation: The overall plan of subjects, content, and activities that make up a school's instructional program. Used for both compulsory education and higher education in Japan. Organized by the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT) for public schools, with each school adapting the national curriculum to its own context.

examples.japanese: {教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい}を{見直|みなお}す。
{新|あたら}しい{教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい}が{来年度|らいねんど}から{始|はじ}まる。
examples.english: The new curriculum will begin next academic year.

examples.japanese: この{大学|だいがく}の{教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい}は{実習|じっしゅう}を{重視|じゅうし}している。
examples.english: This university's curriculum places emphasis on practical training.

examples.japanese: {文部科学省|もんぶかがくしょう}は{十年|じゅうねん}ごとに{教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい}の{基準|きじゅん}を{改訂|かいてい}している。
examples.english: The Ministry of Education revises the curriculum standards every ten years.

notes:
Formed from {教育|きょういく} (education) + {課程|かてい} (course, program). A formal term used in education administration, school management, and academic writing.

USAGE:
- In Japan, the national standard for public school curricula is the {学習|がくしゅう}{指導|しどう}{要領|ようりょう} (Course of Study), and individual schools design their own {教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい} based on it.
- At the university level, {教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい} refers to the program of courses leading to a degree. It is also used for {教員|きょういん}{養成|ようせい}{課程|かてい} (teacher training program).
- More formal than カリキュラム (curriculum, the loanword), which is used in everyday conversation and in some academic writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい}を{編成|へんせい}する: to organize / design a curriculum
- {教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい}の{改訂|かいてい}: revision of the curriculum
- {新|しん}{教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい}: the new curriculum
- {教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい}の{基準|きじゅん}: curriculum standards
- {教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい}{表|ひょう}: curriculum chart

SIMILAR WORDS:
- カリキュラム: curriculum — loanword, more conversational, same basic meaning
- {学習|がくしゅう}{指導|しどう}{要領|ようりょう}: MEXT's national course of study — the framework that guides {教育|きょういく}{課程|かてい}
- {授業|じゅぎょう}{計画|けいかく}: lesson plan — a narrower, individual-lesson-level plan
- シラバス: syllabus — a single course's outline
